name: Demerara Drift
description: A faceted portrait floats beside a generous serif title, above a crystal-strewn diagonal seam and an open letter.

name: Muscovado Press
description: A pressed-sugar slab: oversized stacked type, a tiny stamped corner, and a recessed writing page between granular cut edges.

name: Molasses Manuscript
description: A narrow portrait and a curling molasses trace form the spine of a long letter, with the title crossing a fine horizontal colour bar.

name: Turbinado Terrace
description: Two stepped square portraits sit at different heights above a stair-set title, a small crystal mosaic, and a wide writing terrace.

name: Soft Brown Reverie
description: An airy centred title sits above a shallow portrait window and a broad letter, framed by tiny sugar grains and a double scoop-shaped finish.

name: Grainline
description: An angular touch phone with a grain-dotted camera corner, a square contact portrait, and soft incoming message bubbles.

name: Molassenger
description: A landscape pocket messenger places a vertical clock rail beside a recessed screen, above a miniature spacebar keyboard.

name: Caster Call
description: A compact clamshell handset separates its portrait contact screen from the conversation with a wide double hinge and a small navigation key.

name: Duo Crystal
description: A tall paired-contact phone with two overlapping crystal windows, a divided colour casing, and a fine message timeline.

name: Treacle Terminal
description: A square handheld terminal frames monospace messages inside a rounded display, with a tiny activity light and staggered hardware keys.

name: Grainlet
description: An open miniature note fastened by a double colour corner and three scattered sugar crystals.

name: Sugar Pin
description: A tiny faceted portrait pins a short reply to a slim member-colour binding.

name: Brown Kiss
description: A short, broad reply meets two little overlapping portrait tiles tucked into the lower right corner.

name: Crumbscript
description: A compact label with inset notch details, a narrow uppercase name band, and a small serif reply title.

name: Last Crystal
description: A quiet italic note rests over three tiny tilted crystal tiles and an interrupted colour rule.
